limitations.quote: // Advance each binary pointer and its Gray encoding on the RAM access edge.
limitations.note: The agent fixed the inverted RAM read enable but also removed the original cycle of delay between binary and Gray pointer updates, changing when `wfull` and `rempty` transition.
The scoreboard used the DUT's own flags to decide which transfers to count, so it could verify data ordering without detecting that `wfull` or `rempty` changed on the wrong cycle.
